title: Designing Information in a Forest: Algorithmic Aspects
abstract: arXiv:2611.16327v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The Bayesian persuasion framework models strategic information revelation by a sender to one or more receivers. We study an intricate version of the multi-receiver persuasion setting in which the communication hierarchy is a forest - i.e., some receivers observe more informative signals than others, and the partial ordering of the receivers according to the information they get is represented by a pre-specified directed forest. This model naturally captures interactions in hierarchical organizations, and it lies in between the two most commonly studied versions of Bayesian persuasion: private persuasion and public persuasion. Inspired by the classic model of private persuasion, we focus on a setting with a binary state of nature and binary-action heterogeneous receivers s.t. the sender's utility is a monotone function of the set of receivers taking a specific desirable action. translated_title: 森林中的信息设计：算法视角
translated_abstract: 贝叶斯说服框架对发送者向一个或多个接收者进行策略性信息披露的行为进行建模。我们研究了多接收者说服问题的一个复杂版本，其中通信层级构成一个森林——即部分接收者观测到的信号比其他接收者更具信息量，接收者按所获信息形成的偏序关系由一个预先指定的有向森林来表示。该模型自然地刻画了层级组织中的交互，且介于贝叶斯说服两类最常被研究的设定——私人说服与公共说服——之间。受经典私人说服模型的启发，我们聚焦于自然状态为二元、接收者异质且动作为二元的设定，其中发送者的效用是采取特定期望动作的接收者集合的单调函数。我们扩展了计算易处理性结果（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文将贝叶斯说服扩展到通信层级为有向森林的多接收者设定，并证明了该模型下最优信息设计策略的计算可解性。
en_tdlr: This paper extends Bayesian persuasion to a multi-receiver setting whose communication hierarchy forms a directed forest, and establishes computational tractability results for optimal information design in this model.
